scope.description: Translate Van Gogh's observable directional mark-making, local blue-yellow color structure, and tactile paint into new subjects without copying a named composition or treating a famous motif as mandatory.
limitations: Do not make a night sky, cypress, village, or sunflower a default subject; follow the user's requested subject.
Do not infer that every mark in Van Gogh's work follows one uniform curve or direction.

rules.instruction: Assign distinct mark families to each surface: curved or interlocking strokes for moving atmospheres, short grouped marks for foliage, and longer directional strokes for ground or built forms.
rules.observable: Mark direction changes with the surface or movement, and focal forms remain legible beneath the stroke rhythm.
rules.reject_when: One repeated swirl covers every object, or marks become random noise unrelated to form.
rules.avoid: one uniform spiral texture across the entire image

rules.instruction: Place warm yellow or ochre accents against selected blue-violet fields and use chromatic greens or earth colors where the subject supports them; keep each relationship attached to a form or light source.
rules.observable: Cool and warm passages shape focal hierarchy, with dark anchors and intervening color transitions still visible.
rules.reject_when: A blue overlay with scattered yellow dots substitutes for structured color relationships.
rules.avoid: global blue filter and unstructured yellow speckles

rules.instruction: Show loaded oil paint through raised, directional stroke edges and varied stroke length; keep highlights materially painted instead of airbrushed.
rules.observable: The painted surface remains tactile at close range while major masses stay readable at a distance.
rules.reject_when: Smooth digital shading or a uniform bump texture replaces visible, varied paint marks.
rules.avoid: airbrushed glow and uniform embossed texture

joint_checks.instruction: Make mark direction, local color contrast, and paint load reinforce the same forms; retain an original composition that follows the user's subject.
joint_checks.observable: Stroke families clarify the forms carrying the warm-cool contrasts, and paint remains materially visible without reproducing a recognized composition.
